evidence_notice: Preserves v2 electrical values. Noci-2nd-order-PN→Ipsigoro net positive context route is anatomy-backed and functionally constrained, but exact unitary sign/effect and transfer are unmeasured. Noci input pulse and all electrical magnitudes remain explicit engineering assumptions. MBON-d1→Ipsigoro negative and Ipsigoro→Goro positive remain literature-constrained net effect classes represented as simplified signed edges.

chemical_edges.warning: Signs encode reported functional effect classes where available, not unitary synaptic physiology; magnitudes, delays, transfer through omitted cells, and KC-to-MBON efficacy remain uncertain.

category_by_direction.MBON-d1_to_Ipsigoro: LITERATURE-CONSTRAINED net effect class / simplified signed edge
category_by_direction.Ipsigoro_to_Goro: LITERATURE-CONSTRAINED net effect class / simplified signed edge
category_by_direction.Noci-2nd-order-PN_to_Ipsigoro: LITERATURE-CONSTRAINED net positive context effect; individual edge efficacy unknown

modulatory_edges.representation: DAN-d1 remains a separate modulatory event source; task feedback connection is a future explicit engineering overlay

plasticity.candidate_mask: all KC_to_MBON-d1 rows, inferred and not compartment-local
plasticity.learning_rule: DAN-d1-gated KC_to_MBON-d1 LTD is an independently motivated INFERRED hypothesis; no learning implemented in this reference.

sensory_boundary.signal: current visible position bin represented by a fixed nonoverlapping 8-KC population code
sensory_boundary.codebook: sort KC source IDs ascending; divide them into 8 consecutive groups as evenly as possible; position bin 0..7 selects its group
sensory_boundary.selection_basis: predeclared physical fixture: with tau_m=10 ms, 12 mV-equivalent constant drive yields a single-cell threshold crossing within 1 ms; fixed before any circuit-level response is inspected

context_channel.name: fixed noxious context
context_channel.sign: positive net effect at Ipsigoro; exact PN-edge sign/weight unknown
context_channel.category: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION for input encoding and scale; anatomical route measured
context_channel.selection_basis: Reuse the pre-frozen KC sensory drive magnitude and duration; no behavioral outcome used to select this context scale.

action_boundary.threshold: at least one Goro spike in a 100 ms response window
action_boundary.key_down: one fixed action if threshold met; otherwise no action
action_boundary.selection_basis: minimal integer event threshold fixed before circuit-level response is inspected

precommitment: Only the two downstream net effect signs differ from v1, based on independently reviewed third-instar functional evidence. All numeric values, topology, sensory input, and action threshold are inherited unchanged. No outcome-based tuning. This frozen version receives one neutral and fixed controllability test; failure ends this version.
